notes: Action-proposal golden expectations over demo dataset v1 (development set — ADR 0002). Checks deterministic composition, evidence grounding, exact typed payloads, stable origins, injection containment and usefulness. A separate blind holdout/adversarial set remains required before the Stage 10 pilot gate.

usefulness_rubric.description: Human rubric applied to the approval inbox at the Stage 6 gate; automated proxies guard regressions.
criteria: The proposed action is a practical next step for its evidence
Every executor input is visible before approval
The rationale explains why the action was proposed without unsupported claims
The proposal is clearly simulated and requires explicit approval
